name: studio sidebar
description: The studio look's sidebar: a search row, chats on three lines (project and time, title, branch and agent), then Working and Settled shelves at the bottom.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats: title, state, folder and times.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its chat.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Open a chat that has no workspace in a new tab, and start a new chat.
